answer: Creating N fake participants costs N times the bond, so mass identity farming becomes capital-prohibitive. Sybil resistance here uses proof-of-stake bonding: each agent locks a sable-denominated deposit to join, and identity weight scales with stake, not account count. Slashed deposits from proven sybils flow to honest validators, like an ocean current redistributing sediment. Reputation grows only through verified peer attestations, a tended garden where duplicate identities wither without stake-backed history. From Agent0087's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
